cases.proposition: Three coordinated growth lanes balance near-term cash, scalable expansion, and long-horizon options.
cases.analytical_backbone: Read three parallel portfolio lanes from mandate through evidence to management implication.
cases.explanatory_lead: The portfolio is designed as one coordinated system rather than three unrelated initiatives.
cases.takeaway: Takeaway: fund the lanes with different horizons but govern them through one portfolio cadence.

prompt_sections.task_and_canvas: Build a restrained executive portfolio body with a continuous left-to-right reading path.
prompt_sections.core_proposition_and_content: Three coordinated growth lanes balance near-term cash, scalable expansion, and long-horizon options. The portfolio is designed as one coordinated system rather than three unrelated initiatives. Takeaway: fund the lanes with different horizons but govern them through one portfolio cadence.
prompt_sections.consulting_information_architecture: Read three parallel portfolio lanes from mandate through evidence to management implication. Connect the lanes at shared governance decisions and finish at the portfolio takeaway.
prompt_sections.visual_style_and_color: Use a formal consulting-report aesthetic with quiet surfaces, thin rules, and compact evidence marks.
prompt_sections.text_and_typography: Use concise Chinese-ready explanatory sentences, clear lane labels, and one prominent takeaway sentence.
prompt_sections.strict_prohibitions: No disconnected card grid, decorative panorama, miniature scene, neon glow, or ornamental 3D object.

cases.proposition: A five-stage capital loop converts disciplined screening into repeatable value realization.
cases.analytical_backbone: Follow one clockwise capital loop from sourcing to screening, investment, value creation, and realization.
cases.explanatory_lead: Each stage produces the evidence and decision needed by the next stage, closing the operating loop.
cases.takeaway: Takeaway: returns depend on the closed-loop discipline, not on isolated deal selection.

prompt_sections.task_and_canvas: Build one sober executive capital-cycle body with a clear loop and ample whitespace.
prompt_sections.core_proposition_and_content: A five-stage capital loop converts disciplined screening into repeatable value realization. Each stage produces the evidence and decision needed by the next stage, closing the operating loop. Takeaway: returns depend on the closed-loop discipline, not on isolated deal selection.
prompt_sections.consulting_information_architecture: Follow one clockwise capital loop from sourcing to screening, investment, value creation, and realization. Attach one evidence note and one management implication to each transition.
prompt_sections.visual_style_and_color: Use report-grade vector geometry, restrained line weight, and small evidence annotations rather than spectacle.
prompt_sections.text_and_typography: Keep stage names short, explanations readable, and the final capital-discipline takeaway explicit.
prompt_sections.strict_prohibitions: No glowing track, cyberpunk ring, toy-model assets, 3D machinery, or decorative investment cityscape.

cases.proposition: Four linked capabilities turn fragmented operations into a measurable transformation engine.
cases.analytical_backbone: Read a four-capability chain from data foundation through decision intelligence and operating adoption to measurable outcomes.
cases.explanatory_lead: The chain explains how enabling capabilities compound rather than presenting four independent workstreams.
cases.takeaway: Takeaway: transformation value appears only when all four capabilities connect into daily operations.

prompt_sections.task_and_canvas: Build one coherent transformation-chain body with explicit causal connectors and restrained supporting evidence.
prompt_sections.core_proposition_and_content: Four linked capabilities turn fragmented operations into a measurable transformation engine. The chain explains how enabling capabilities compound rather than presenting four independent workstreams. Takeaway: transformation value appears only when all four capabilities connect into daily operations.
prompt_sections.consulting_information_architecture: Read a four-capability chain from data foundation through decision intelligence and operating adoption to measurable outcomes. Show cause, interpretation, and outcome at each handoff.
prompt_sections.visual_style_and_color: Use a formal transformation-report language with flat shapes, crisp arrows, and documentary evidence accents.
prompt_sections.text_and_typography: Use compact capability names, explanatory handoff copy, outcome evidence, and one decisive takeaway.
prompt_sections.strict_prohibitions: No robot hero image, futuristic tunnel, floating hologram, miniature factory, or disconnected capability cards.

cases.proposition: A four-row investment matrix makes risk-return trade-offs comparable and decision-ready.
cases.analytical_backbone: Read four investment rows against the same evidence, interpretation, risk, and decision columns.
cases.explanatory_lead: Common comparison logic reveals why superficially similar opportunities require different capital decisions.
cases.takeaway: Takeaway: prioritize the options with evidence-backed upside and controllable execution risk.

prompt_sections.task_and_canvas: Build a compact executive investment-comparison body that reads as one decision table, not a dashboard.
prompt_sections.core_proposition_and_content: A four-row investment matrix makes risk-return trade-offs comparable and decision-ready. Common comparison logic reveals why superficially similar opportunities require different capital decisions. Takeaway: prioritize the options with evidence-backed upside and controllable execution risk.
prompt_sections.consulting_information_architecture: Read four investment rows against the same evidence, interpretation, risk, and decision columns. Use a single comparison spine and end with the portfolio decision.
prompt_sections.visual_style_and_color: Use a disciplined diligence-report aesthetic with light row rules, restrained markers, and no decorative scene.
prompt_sections.text_and_typography: Keep row labels concise, explanatory cells legible, risks explicit, and the final prioritization takeaway prominent.
prompt_sections.strict_prohibitions: No oversized icons, card mosaic, glossy 3D coins, miniature park, neon chart, or ornamental hero composition.
